name: safwan-portfolio
description: Safwan Ahmad — Full-Stack Developer Portfolio (React/Vite frontend + Node/Express/MongoDB backend)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && npm run format --prefix backend
